findings.claim: The due-date check only catches ValueError, so a stored due that is not a string (null, number) makes parse_date raise TypeError and crash with a traceback.
findings.failure_scenario: Task file holds an open task {"id": 1, "title": "a", "done": false, "due": null} (or "due": 20261001); `tasklist list --overdue` reaches re.fullmatch on a non-string, raises TypeError, and exits with a traceback instead of exit 2 plus one stderr line naming the task.
findings.rule: AC-1 (malformed stored due date: exit 2, one stderr line, no traceback)
